mapper.select: select state, source_ref as sourceRef, delta_millis as deltaMillis, horizon_millis as horizonMillis, lower_effective_events as lowerEffectiveEvents, max_events as maxEvents, page_size as pageSize from city_fairness_parameter where state = 'APPROVED'

select source_ref as source, event_id as eventId, outing_id as outingId, kind, actor_id as actorId, occurred_at as occurredAt, join_time as joinTime, team_size as teamSize, action_cost as actionCost, newcomer, gain_amount as gainAmount, verification_millis as verificationMillis from city_fairness_event where actor_id = #{actorId} and occurred_at > #{windowStartExclusive} and occurred_at <= #{asOfInclusive} order by occurred_at, source_ref, event_id limit #{limit}

select source_ref as source, event_id as eventId, outing_id as outingId, kind, actor_id as actorId, occurred_at as occurredAt, join_time as joinTime, team_size as teamSize, action_cost as actionCost, newcomer, gain_amount as gainAmount, verification_millis as verificationMillis from city_fairness_event where source_ref = #{source} and event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: insert into city_fairness_read (account_id, query_id, as_of, payload) values (#{accountId}, #{queryId}, #{asOf}, #{payload})
mapper.select: select account_id as accountId, query_id as queryId, as_of as asOf, payload from city_fairness_read where account_id = #{accountId} and query_id = #{queryId}
